nodes.label: .github/workflows/pages.yml
nodes.summary: Builds and publishes the committed presentation, shared viewer, saved JSON snapshot and hero MP4 through GitHub Pages. The build job receives contents/pages read permissions; deployment separately receives pages write and id-token write. It does not read the local knowledge database.

nodes.label: Meaningful knowledge maintenance by the agent
nodes.summary: The agent reads source code and maintains a semantic graph of code, architecture, findings and decisions. Search aids navigation but does not replace understanding; a full pass starts on an explicit request.

nodes.label: Bound navigation and graph mutations
nodes.summary: The bound CLI uses the verified local receipt for scope and root. Navigation, references and check/stats share read snapshots; node/edge/evidence/detail writes share atomic mutation chains with audit history, optional compact output, known activity labels and mechanical source/concurrency guards.

nodes.label: Unified graph and v3 schema
nodes.summary: SQLite stores the shared nodes/edges graph, scope snapshots, provenance evidence and supported symbol and file details. Types and layers are field values; the schema is shared by the tool and viewer.

nodes.label: Local graph viewer
nodes.summary: The local browser interface displays the SQLite graph, details, filters, timeline and activity highlights. Requires schema v3. The interface supports exploration but does not create semantic knowledge or establish graph completeness.

nodes.label: Persistent history of changes and calls
nodes.summary: A managed v3 database stores row changes through triggers and SQL call events in the same file. The journal contains before/after values and element references. Rolling back changes does not erase information about the failed SQL call; history is not automatically cleaned up.

nodes.label: Presentation and static demonstration
nodes.summary: The presentation uses the supplied prerecorded hero MP4 and a separate embedded interactive saved-graph preview, both alongside the full shared viewer demo. A read-only exporter publishes all graph rows, public evidence and saved history; initial activity pages are bounded and full resources load lazily. GitHub Pages deploys the committed artifacts rather than reading a live local database.

nodes.label: Advisory graph quality and storage diagnostics
nodes.summary: Read-only check/stats expose structural review prompts, current evidence coverage, mechanical source/hash bounds and measured storage. Structural connectivity and valid locators do not certify semantic completeness.

nodes.label: Bounded SQL execution
nodes.summary: The Python API and SQL CLI share a contract of native SQL statements with parameters, bounded results and explicit transactions. A transaction left open at request end is rolled back. Successful SQL does not establish that knowledge is true.

nodes.label: Self-hosting with normal authorization and isolation
nodes.summary: The public prohibition on using EvoMneme on itself, forks and worktrees was lifted at the user's request. The same explicit authorization, identity verification, separate project database and Git exclusions apply as for other hosts. Isolated tests remain separate from persistent memory; permission does not automatically activate it on any checkout.

nodes.label: Old pages are preserved in the bounded window
nodes.summary: The viewer retains at most 10000 loaded activities. Explicit older paging removes the newer end, while ordinary polling removes the older end; the separate recording window preserves its previous behavior. Deduplication and both cursors remain independent.

nodes.label: CLI instead of a custom MCP adapter
nodes.summary: History records removal of the EvoMneme MCP adapter at the user's request. Ordinary navigation and graph maintenance use the CLI; advanced SQL uses the Python API/SQL CLI. Earlier MCP records remain historical.

nodes.label: Full history loads separately
nodes.summary: The manifest contains the exact latest 100 calls+100 changes; remaining events stay complete in history.json and are accessible through native cursors. replay.json loads only when replay is opened; preview and dedicated demo use one renderer.

nodes.label: Tool changes through its own project chat
nodes.summary: Personal owner rule: host chats continue maintaining host memory but do not edit the EvoMneme checkout or use its database for independent tool development. A separate chat in the saved EvoMneme project is created when improvements are needed; it uses its own canonical database, checks sources and decides independently. The rule is stored in local HOME/.codex/AGENTS.md, not the public skill.

nodes.label: Semantic graph instead of a lexical dump
nodes.summary: Recorded decision: meaningful direct relationships and minimal entities instead of a mechanical dump, test internals, and gap/review nodes. The reasons are navigation usefulness and avoiding false completeness; uncertainty remains in attributes.

nodes.label: Population maintenance improvements
nodes.summary: Implemented authorized CLI-first population/detail maintenance, read-only structural/source/storage diagnostics, optional compact output and activity identities, expected timestamp/source guards and four source-grounded retrieval controls. Independent follow-up review passed; coordinator reports all 176 assigned tests passed, including 67 postfix integrated checks. Memory reconciliation is task-scoped and partial; no universal coverage, fresh-agent adoption or measured efficiency gain is established. Source guards detect specific races without filesystem locking. Journal stays ON; a default change remains an undecided TODO. Website/export/viewer remains separately owned.

nodes.label: Publishing only the verified public slice
nodes.summary: With explicit user authorization, publishes the entire current project graph, all layers and provenance attachments, rather than a fixed FILES/RECORD_IDS slice. Runtime identities, host paths and actually sensitive attachment cells are excluded; source identity is checked against the excluded receipt.

nodes.label: A public link requires proof of a published blob
nodes.summary: The analyzed scope revision may be local and unpublished. A public link is provided only when the recorded SHA256 matches the file in an explicitly verified published commit; absence of proof preserves provenance without a URL.

nodes.label: Full public graph and saved history
nodes.summary: The demo preserves all graph rows and layers, all available node/edge typed before/after values for native replay and all saved calls/changes. No fictional history is created for the period before the journal began. Export is read-only; source and graph are not migrated.

nodes.label: CLI does not write detail tables
nodes.summary: Historical observation: the former bound maintenance CLI could not populate symbol_details/file_details. Resolved by schema-v3 add/update/delete symbol-details and file-details commands; the original empty-detail observation remains historical.

nodes.label: Test precondition: .evomneme is absent
nodes.summary: Resolved: the outdated assert that project .evomneme is absent was replaced with a fixture-local knowledge store with a sentinel. The test now allows an existing store, checks mandatory explicit Python/CLI binding and unchanged sentinel; the old demo restriction no longer applies.

nodes.label: Website text lags behind MCP removal
nodes.summary: The historical finding about the outdated MCP description is fixed in the current presentation: ordinary transport is described as CLI/SQL. The original locators of the old text are no longer verified.

nodes.label: migrations/002_to_003.sql
nodes.summary: Published transactional migration only for unmodified official v2: the guard checks versions, structure, absence of foreign tables/triggers/views and FK violations; renames records/relations while preserving IDs and provenance.

nodes.label: queries/anchors.sql
nodes.summary: Literal discovery for the selected current scope: exact ID/title/file path or literal title prefix, optional path prefix, keyset cursor and one lookahead. Does not use broad substring search.

nodes.label: queries/architecture.sql
nodes.summary: Paged orientation by knowledge kind without task keywords or path predicate. Preview limited to 0–240 characters, page1–32 with lookahead.

nodes.label: queries/declarations.sql
nodes.summary: Explicit inventory of current code entities for one exact source_path with kind filter and keyset paging; file selection does not replace semantic analysis.

nodes.label: queries/evidence.sql
nodes.summary: Current evidence for a selected current node/edge target within one scope. Exact parent filter, keyset paging, and lookahead; stale attachments are not promoted to current.

nodes.label: queries/incident.sql
nodes.summary: One step along current resolved edges between current endpoints. Preserves stored direction, uncertainty and both participants' locators; kind filter and keyset paging.

nodes.label: queries/neighborhood.sql
nodes.summary: One native recursive statement for cross-type traversal. Separates traverse_kind and result_kind, supports incoming/outgoing/both and minimum depth, excludes stale intermediate nodes/edges; maximum depth 0-32 and a final LIMIT.

nodes.label: queries/node.sql
nodes.summary: Full detail row for one current node by explicit scope/id; also supports pathless knowledge.

nodes.label: queries/scopes.sql
nodes.summary: Paged discovery of source/version scopes: returns branch/worktree/revision/snapshot and created_at with a keyset cursor. The caller must choose applicability; the newest scope is not selected automatically.

nodes.label: EvoMneme
nodes.summary: EvoMneme provides portable instructions for an AI agent and a local SQLite graph of code, architecture, findings and decisions. The agent reads sources meaningfully and maintains knowledge; the SQL executor runs queries, while the CLI and viewer provide navigation. There is no built-in automatic code analyzer.

nodes.label: schema.sql
nodes.summary: Canonical v3 schema: shared graph, scopes, evidence, symbol and file details, indexes, and two version markers. Initializes only an empty store through an explicit SQLite-script operation.

nodes.label: WebsiteExportTests.test_cli_three_outputs_and_validation_failure_preserves_previous_export
nodes.summary: Checks CLI writing of three JSON files, staged outputs and preservation of previous artifacts on validation/serialization error.

nodes.label: WebsiteExportTests.test_entire_native_history_replay_and_calls_survive_sanitization
nodes.summary: Checks every native history event beyond 200 pagination, typed replay and exact initial 100+100 pages.

nodes.label: false_v3_guard
nodes.summary: Checks rejection of legacy tables even with user_version=3.

nodes.label: WebsiteExportTests.test_legacy_tables_with_v3_user_version_rejected
nodes.summary: Establishes that user_version3 without v3 tables and metadata marker is not accepted.

nodes.label: WebsiteExportTests.test_public_knowledge_updates_preserved_but_credentials_rejected
nodes.summary: Preserves new authorized public knowledge claims; actual credential patterns block publication.

nodes.label: export_private_boundary
nodes.summary: Checks unchanged bytes, allowlisted cells/endpoints and deterministic export.

nodes.label: WebsiteExportTests.test_reusable_public_revision_override_preserves_recorded_scope
nodes.summary: Checks reusable public revision override without substituting analyzed source scopes.

nodes.label: WebsiteExportTests.test_source_links_require_verified_public_blob_not_analyzed_revision
nodes.summary: Checks public blob proof, absence of fake links for analyzed revision, missing hash and unsafe path.

nodes.label: WebsiteExportTests.test_unknown_scope_revisions_preserved_without_fabricated_links
nodes.summary: Preserves all rows of an unknown scope revision without creating source URLs without proof.

nodes.label: export_schema_guard
nodes.summary: Checks read-only refusal of unsupported/incomplete schemas.

nodes.label: WebsiteExportTests.test_unsupported_and_incomplete_schema_rejected_read_only
nodes.summary: Rejects invalid markers and an incomplete v3 contract before changing source.

nodes.label: WebsiteExportTests.test_whole_graph_all_scopes_layers_prose_and_read_only
nodes.summary: Checks all scopes/layers and prose/evidence preservation, absence of private extras and unchanged source bytes.

nodes.label: WebsiteExportTests.test_wrong_host_project_is_rejected_before_publication
nodes.summary: Rejects source with a different project identity without changing its bytes.

nodes.label: reviewed_revision_guard
nodes.summary: Checks rejection of revisions outside the reviewed public revision.

nodes.label: tests/test_website_static.js
nodes.summary: Checks the shipped adapter, readiness, all evidence, exact native replay roundtrips, full history cursors and lazy initial/timeline/replay loading.

nodes.label: readinessTests
nodes.summary: Checks shipped browser mock readiness/error gating and initial-page optimization: no timeline fetch until explicit older, replay lazy/cached.

nodes.label: website/assets/mark.svg
nodes.summary: EvoMneme vector favicon: dark/mint E mark with orbit and nodes; linked through the landing page's relative asset URL, without an external service.

nodes.label: website/demo/demo.css
nodes.summary: Styles the public demo and opt-in embed without a separate graph renderer; displays saved activity/replay controls, hiding only unavailable live/SQL operations.

nodes.label: website/demo/demo.js
nodes.summary: Loads the snapshot and adapts fetch/DOM chrome of the shared viewer. Latest 100+100 activities are included in the manifest, full timeline/replay are requested lazily; readiness depends on an accepted snapshot and completed rendering.

nodes.label: historyResource
nodes.summary: Lazily reads and caches only safe adjacent manifest JSON resources; replay is separate from timeline.

nodes.label: demo: static API initialization callback
nodes.summary: Passes loaded JSON to createAPI, preserving runtime validation of the static contract.

nodes.label: demo: snapshot failure callback
nodes.summary: On loading/validation error, sets error state and rethrows the error.

nodes.label: demo: snapshot response callback
nodes.summary: Checks HTTP response.ok and reads public snapshot JSON; does not mask an error with an empty graph.

nodes.label: demo: provenance callback
nodes.summary: Displays recorded analyzed revision separately from verified public revision, counts/limits, saved history controls and explicit source evidence in the inspector.

nodes.label: demo: inspector source-link callback
nodes.summary: Marks absent attached evidence with an accurate hint and adds source links only through the proof policy adapter.

nodes.label: demo: provenance failure callback
nodes.summary: Displays a provenance promise error in the information panel.

nodes.label: demo: viewer status observer callback
nodes.summary: Marks ready only after an accepted snapshot and completed draw with counters; preserves error on failures, accurately labels storage/journal chrome as a fixed public export.

nodes.label: demo: window.fetch adapter
nodes.summary: Redirects only same-origin /api routes to the static adapter; uses initial pages without the full timeline, waits for resources lazily.

nodes.label: website/demo/static-api.js
nodes.summary: Read-only static implementation of the shared viewer contracts over the full public graph, evidence/details and native replay/timeline. Public links are allowed only through an explicit verified source_url.

nodes.label: static-api.createAPI
nodes.summary: Indexes opaque graph IDs and scope/id separately; serves standard snapshot/detail/replay/history contracts without a SQLite engine.

nodes.label: static-api.createAPI.detail
nodes.summary: Returns all evidence by scope and node/edge parent, supported symbol attributes and file coverage without a hidden 200-attachment limit.

nodes.label: createAPI.initialHistory
nodes.summary: Serves latest pages and immutable polling-after-last from the initial manifest without loading the full timeline; delegates older/early cursors to the full file.

nodes.label: static-api.createAPI.request
nodes.summary: Routes snapshot/detail, native saved replay and both cursor history pages; SQL and write routes are absent.

nodes.label: static-api.createAPI.snapshot
nodes.summary: Filters and groups the full published graph; provides native journal status and does not change source rows.

nodes.label: static-api.createAPI.sourceLink
nodes.summary: Exports the proof sourceLink callback for the inspector; does not derive a URL from source_path alone.

nodes.label: historyPage
nodes.summary: Preserves independent ascending native cursor streams with latest/before/after, limit1..200 and accurate has_older/has_more.

nodes.label: static-api.sourceLink
nodes.summary: Returns only an explicit URL for the exact repository/public_revision/path; there is no link without a hash-verified source_url.

nodes.label: website/index.html
nodes.summary: English EvoMneme presentation with a passive saved-graph MP4 hero and the real entire project graph in the shared interactive viewer below. The user-supplied video autoplays muted and loops inline without controls; the SQL example is an explicitly translated stored evidence trail. Getting-started cards link to published navigation and SQL guides.

nodes.label: website/site.css
nodes.summary: Responsive English presentation styling and shared-viewer iframe framing. The hero video keeps its intrinsic aspect ratio, ignores pointer input, and uses a separate caption; CSS does not define the graph model.

nodes.label: website/site.js
nodes.summary: Progressive landing page enhancement: current section highlighting and controlled iframe viewer. Readiness is determined by snapshot marker plus canvas; errors/timeouts provide a direct demo link; interaction is explicitly enabled and disabled with Escape.

nodes.label: site.checkViewer
nodes.summary: Checks the publicSnapshotState marker and error messages; ready requires the ready marker and a real canvas. Translates iframe access errors into fallback.

nodes.label: site.frameObserver
nodes.summary: Current iframe MutationObserver, replaced after document reload.

nodes.label: site.loadTimer
nodes.summary: Handle of the 20-second fallback timer; cleared on ready or load error.

nodes.label: site: timeout callback
nodes.summary: The passed setTimeout callback displays fallback after 20000 ms if the viewer is not ready.

nodes.label: site: navigation IntersectionObserver callback
nodes.summary: The callback passed to the browser observer reconciles aria-current on the nav link with the corresponding section's visibility.

nodes.label: site.observeViewer
nodes.summary: Disconnects the old observer, subscribes the new document to DOM changes and Escape, checks current state. Called on load event and for an already loaded cached iframe.

nodes.label: site: iframe keydown callback
nodes.summary: The callback registered on the iframe document disables interaction on Escape and restores button focus without scrolling.

nodes.label: site.observer
nodes.summary: IntersectionObserver for current navigation sections; uses rootMargin and the supplied browser callback.

nodes.label: site.ready
nodes.summary: Iframe readiness state; true only with an accepted snapshot and canvas, blocks premature graph entry.

nodes.label: site.sectionLinks
nodes.summary: List of navigation anchor links to landing page sections.

nodes.label: site.setInteraction
nodes.summary: Consistently changes iframe inert/tabIndex, CSS class, aria-pressed, button text and instructions for explicit exploration mode.

nodes.label: site.showFallback
nodes.summary: Resets readiness and interaction, hides the button and displays a message with a direct demo link.

nodes.label: site.viewer
nodes.summary: DOM reference to iframe memory-viewer; initially inert in HTML.

nodes.label: site: iframe error callback
nodes.summary: The registered error callback displays a fallback link in place of the unavailable embedded viewer.

nodes.label: site.viewerFrame
nodes.summary: Iframe container accepting the is-interactive class.

nodes.label: site.viewerInstructions
nodes.summary: Accessible text description of the current interaction mode.

nodes.label: site.viewerLoading
nodes.summary: Loading indicator or fallback link to the full demonstration.

nodes.label: site.viewerToggle
nodes.summary: Button to explicitly enable and disable graph interaction.

nodes.label: site: interaction toggle callback
nodes.summary: The click callback checks ready, toggles the mode and focuses the iframe on entry without scrolling.
